findings.title: ManageEngine security advisory: remote code execution vulnerability in the Reports module (CVE-2026-12507)
findings.summary_md: ManageEngine's advisory page for CVE-2026-12507 lists the flaw as fixed in AssetExplorer 7860 and ServiceDesk Plus 15290 on June 19, 2026, and in ServiceDesk Plus MSP 15150 and SupportCenter Plus 15150 on June 22, 2026. Affected builds are AssetExplorer 7850 and below, ServiceDesk Plus 15280 and below, ServiceDesk Plus MSP 15140 and below, and SupportCenter Plus 15140 and below. The advisory states an authenticated user holding the Create Query Reports permission could run specially crafted database queries with Jasper expressions and execute arbitrary commands. The report came in through ManageEngine's bug bounty portal.

findings.title: CVE-2026-12591: authenticated privilege escalation to remote code execution in M365 Manager Plus
findings.summary_md: ManageEngine's advisory page for CVE-2026-12591 lists builds 4817 and earlier as affected and build 4818 as the fixed version, with a fix date of June 24, 2026. An authenticated technician can exploit insufficient permission validation in the delegated administration interface to escalate privileges beyond the intended scope and reach remote code execution during administrative processing. The page rates the issue High and credits the report to a researcher via the Zoho bug bounty program.

findings.title: M365 Manager Plus release notes: build 4818 security fix for CVE-2026-12591
findings.summary_md: The vendor release notes list build 4818 as released on June 24, 2026 with a single issue fix: CVE-2026-12591, the insufficient permission validation flaw in the delegated administration interface. Later builds such as 4820 (July 13, 2026) and 4821 (July 30, 2026) carry unrelated feature and security work. This confirms the CVE number was attached to a service pack that shipped in June, roughly five months before the CVE was published in the NVD in November 2026.
